local_classifier.description: Local classifier-only threshold profile for Task 48. This profile gates deterministic matrix/classifier coverage and explicitly requires provider, compile, runtime, and rollback dimensions to be marked not run.

launch_provider_runtime.description: Launch threshold profile for local provider/accounting plus compile/runtime/rollback benchmark execution. tools/launch_provider_runtime_benchmark.py must provide provider, compile, runtime, rollback, unsupported blocking, cost, latency, and reproducibility dimensions; hosted BYOK reliability remains a separate opt-in proof.

notes: Task 48 defines measurable prompt launch thresholds and makes the benchmark fail below the selected profile.
The local_classifier profile is the fast default; it is expected to pass without provider, compile, runtime, or rollback execution.

The launch_provider_runtime profile is expected to pass when run through tools/launch_provider_runtime_benchmark.py with built SGC/runtime binaries; running it against local classifier-only reports must still fail.
